title: ML Testing & Quality Gates
interviewAnswer: ML systems need software tests plus data/model checks such as schema invariants, leakage tests, slice metrics, baseline comparison, latency bounds and deployment gates.
why: Many ML failures are data/interface failures rather than architecture failures.
intuition: A service can be healthy while receiving impossible feature values, so API tests alone are insufficient.
deepDive: Promotion gates can require schema compatibility, baseline improvement, minimum critical-slice metrics and system constraints before a model becomes deployable.
commonMistakes: Promoting because one aggregate metric improved.
production: Run cheap deterministic checks in CI and heavier validation inside train/deploy pipelines.
workedExample: Block a new model if aggregate AUC rises but recall on a critical rare-event slice falls below policy.
